summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Ukrainian telecom registrant domiciled in the DIFC, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its September 30, 2026 period report, consisting primarily of XBRL-tagged IFRS interim financial statements covering the nine months and third quarter ended September 30, 2026, with comparative periods for 2025 and restated 2024 equity. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms appear in the excerpt. This is an ordinary foreign private issuer periodic update, not a special situation; no deal terms to watch.
